initialLayoutEvidence.scope: The authenticated historical native design retains all 75 structures, all 17 fitting poses and kinds, and all three authored bell appearances. Only false shell/float defaults, an independently frame-equivalent normal alias and relative numeric roundoff of 1e-12 are accepted. New machinery and internal engineering remain independent of these exterior guards.

propulsionEvidence.scope: Independent authenticated source geometry plus explicitly declared source transformations versus the same fresh factory result: expected nozzle mouths, apertures and roles, conserved source plant and shield capacity, and superweapon energy/axis/duration.

auxiliaryBetween.scope: The Imperial auxiliary-between-shafts test does not apply to this stock example.

podPlacement.scope: Every complete paid cylindrical engine is independently sampled against its own unchanged native round-loft nacelle: seven axial sections, each centre and two circular rings of 96 points. No hull union, nozzle or another pod can stand in for its containing bulge.

layoutEvidence.scope: The authenticated historical native design retains all 75 structures, all 17 fitting poses and kinds, and all three authored bell appearances. Only false shell/float defaults, an independently frame-equivalent normal alias and relative numeric roundoff of 1e-12 are accepted. New machinery and internal engineering remain independent of these exterior guards.

accelerationEvidence.scope: The requested catalogue maximum comes from actual body volume at the unchanged ordinary force law, actual engineering mass, structural limit and inertial support. No density boost or separate display-only cap is accepted.

speedEvidence.scope: Independent published MGLT literals from docs/reference-sublight-speeds.md must match the actual fresh profile. Unpublished Arquitens and MC30c remain explicitly assumed; speed overlays preserve the actual thrust, acceleration, power, heat and armament ledgers.

framingEvidence.scope: The exact installed framing grid is integrated independently through its real hull sections. The same actual engineering result must include it in each owned-hull material ledger and in the global framing ledger used by the completed-mass calculation; no second statistics pass or substituted mass is used.
